setup_command: python -m venv --system-site-packages .clawgap-venv && UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/clawgap-uv-cache uv pip install --python .clawgap-venv/bin/python --no-deps -e . 'agentscope==1.0.20' 'agent-client-protocol==0.9.0' 'mcp==1.27.2' 'segno==1.6.6' 'reme-ai==0.3.1.8' 'qdrant-client==1.16.0' && cp ../../../src/runtime_validation/environment_fixtures/python/mcp_streamablehttp_client.py .clawgap-venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/mcp/client/streamablehttp_client.py && .clawgap-venv/bin/python -c 'import mcp.client.streamablehttp_client'
launch_command:
mkdir -p "$HOME/qwenpaw" "$HOME/qwenpaw-secret/providers/custom" && export QWENPAW_WORKING_DIR="$HOME/qwenpaw" QWENPAW_SECRET_DIR="$HOME/qwenpaw-secret" && cat > "$HOME/qwenpaw-secret/providers/custom/clawgap.json" <<EOF
{"id":"clawgap","name":"ClawGap Loopback Fixture","base_url":"http://127.0.0.1:${CLAWGAP_PROVIDER_PORT}/v1","api_key":"clawgap-loopback-mock","chat_model":"OpenAIChatModel","extra_models":[{"id":"clawgap-environment-probe","name":"ClawGap Environment Probe"}]}
EOF
cat > "$HOME/qwenpaw-secret/providers/active_model.json" <<'EOF'
{"provider_id":"clawgap","model":"clawgap-environment-probe"}
EOF
.clawgap-venv/bin/qwenpaw app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18081
probe_command: for second in $(seq 1 20); do QWENPAW_WORKING_DIR="$HOME/qwenpaw" QWENPAW_SECRET_DIR="$HOME/qwenpaw-secret" curl --max-time 20 -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:18081/api/console/chat -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"input":[{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"environment probe"}]}]}' >/dev/null && exit 0; sleep 1; done; exit 1
